carob-island.title: Carob island — candidate geometry
carob-island.summary: Prepared template referencing the existing palette. Counts, numerical spacing and drone clearance require explicit reviewed choices.
limitations: Illustrative association only; not a proven compatible planting recipe or adopted Designer operation.
open_questions: Set counts and resolve central dimensions/density at adoption; validate reservoir footprint and aerial service access.
placement_requirements: Use stable species IDs and current central diameter/density/placement rule identities.
Retain distinct reservoir footprint, root spacing and mature crown assumptions.
Check reachable exposed inlet, rotor/hose clearance, terrain and growth.
Seed random cluster placement; reject or explain unplaced instances rather than omit them.
